He sat for a long while watching the gray waves, then tucked the note into his logbook, between the weather entries, as if it too were something the sky had decided to report.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光铺在空荡的柏油路上，偶尔有一辆出租车滑过，车灯划开一道短暂的痕迹。便利店的玻璃窗里透出冷白的光，店员靠在柜台后面打盹。远处高楼的轮廓模糊成一片深灰，只有几扇窗还亮着，像是谁也没睡。风从巷子口钻出来，带着潮气和一点凉意。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音显得格外清晰。整座城市像是在喘一口气，等着天边泛起第一丝灰蓝，再重新热闹起来。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.\nImagine a set of Russian nesting dolls: to open the biggest one, you open a smaller one inside, and that keeps happening until you reach the tiniest doll.\nThat tiniest doll is called the 'base case', and it's what tells the function to stop instead of calling itself forever."}
